state.question: Seven players independently receive fair red/blue hats. Each sees the six other hats, not their own. They agree on a deterministic strategy beforehand, then simultaneously say red, blue, or pass with no later communication. The team wins iff at least one guesses a color and every color guess is correct. What is the maximum win probability?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.
